traditional: Vitality and authority combined with communication and commerce.

modern.blend: Identity fused with mind and communication. Self-expression runs through ideas and speech. Only the conjunction is possible, since Mercury never travels far from the Sun.
modern.harmonious: Adds mental steadiness and articulacy. You think and speak as an extension of who you are.
modern.hard: Risk of identifying so closely with your own ideas that outside input is hard to take in.
modern.business: Strong for pitching, writing, and putting your own thinking forward in your own voice.

cyclicNote: This pair runs a full conjunction-to-conjunction cycle; waxing/waning phase meaning is carried on the transit entries.
